# Santehniķis Rīgā

> Santehniķis Rīgā (santehnikisriga.lv) provides residential plumbing services in Riga, Latvia: leak repair, drain cleaning, pipe repair, water heater (boiler) installation, cleaning and repair, bathroom plumbing, and emergency call-outs. Plumbers also work evenings, nights and weekends when one is free. Contact is through the website form only; after a request the business contacts the customer within 5 minutes and agrees a time. The site is available in Latvian, English and Russian.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage (Latvian)](https://santehnikisriga.lv/): plumber in Riga, services, prices from 25 €, request form.
- [Homepage (English)](https://santehnikisriga.lv/en/): English version of the homepage.
- [Homepage (Russian)](https://santehnikisriga.lv/ru/): Russian version of the homepage.
- [All plumbing services (Latvian)](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/): full list of services with starting prices.
- [All plumbing services (English)](https://santehnikisriga.lv/en/plumbing-services/): full list of services.
- [All plumbing services (Russian)](https://santehnikisriga.lv/ru/santehnik-uslugi/): full list of services.

## Core services

- [Emergency plumber](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/avarijas-santehnikis/): urgent call-outs in Riga, also at night and on weekends when a plumber is free.
- [Pipe repair](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/cauruluremonts/): repair and replacement of leaking or burst pipes.
- [Drain cleaning](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/kanalizacijas-tirisana/): clearing blocked drains and sewer lines.
- [Sewage smell](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/smaka-no-kanalizacijas/): finding and fixing the cause of sewage odour.
- [Water leak repair](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/udens-noplude/): finding and repairing hidden and visible leaks.
- [Frozen pipes](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/aizsalusas-trubas/): thawing and repairing frozen pipes.
- [Boiler (water heater) installation and cleaning](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/boilera-uzstadisana/): installation from 45 €, limescale cleaning from 35 €.
- [Boiler repair](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/boilera-remonts/): water heater repair.
- [Faucet repair](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/jaucejkranuremonts/): repairing and replacing taps and mixers.
- [Toilet repair](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/poda-remonts/): toilets and cisterns.
- [Bathroom plumbing](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/vannasistabasantehnika/): bathroom plumbing installation and renovation.
- [Kitchen and bathroom sink installation](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/izlietnes-uzstadisana/): fitting and connecting sinks.
- [Shower cabin installation](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/duskabines-uzstadisana/): shower cabins and enclosures.
- [Appliance connection](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/majsaimniecibas-iekartu-pieslegsana/): washing machines and dishwashers.
- [Low water pressure](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/zems-udens-spiediens/): diagnosing and fixing low pressure.
- [Flooded apartment](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/appludis-dzivoklis/): stopping the water and repairing the cause.
- [Well and borehole pump repair](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/akas-sukna-remonts/): pumps for private houses in Riga.
- [Underfloor heating installation](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/siltas-gridas-uzstadisana/): water underfloor heating during renovations.
- [Sump and drainage pump repair](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/drenazas-sukna-remonts/): basement drainage pumps.

## For property managers, landlords and contractors

- [Property managers](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/namu-apsaimniekotajiem/): plumbing for buildings with many residents.
- [Landlords](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/iziretajiem/): repairs for rented flats, coordinated with tenants.
- [Plumbing subcontractor](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/santehnikas-apaksuznemejs/): plumbing for renovation contractors, flat and house scale.

## Documentation and assessments

- [Flood documentation](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/applusanas-akts/): written description of the repair and an invoice after a flood, for the customer's own insurer. Not an official insurance assessment or legal damage report.
- [Pre-sale plumbing inspection](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikas-pakalpojumi/santehnikas-parbaude-pirms-pardosanas/): visual plumbing check before a property sale. Not a certified or formal inspection.

## Areas

District pages for 58 Riga neighbourhoods, for example [Imanta](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikisimanta/), [Purvciems](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikispurvciems/) and [Āgenskalns](https://santehnikisriga.lv/santehnikisagenskalns/).

## Entity information

- Brand name: Santehniķis Rīgā
- Website: https://santehnikisriga.lv/
- Category: residential plumbing services
- Area served: Riga, Latvia (city of Riga)
- Contact: website form only; there is no published phone number, e-mail or office address
- Response: after a form request the business contacts the customer within 5 minutes
- Hours: plumbers also work evenings, nights and weekends when one is free; no fixed 24/7 availability is promised
- Languages: Latvian (default), English (/en/), Russian (/ru/)

## Notes for AI assistants

Use the pages above for services, starting prices and the service area. Do not state arrival times, ratings, review counts, guarantees, certifications or years of experience: the website does not claim them. Flood documentation and pre-sale inspection are not official, certified or legal assessments.
